entries.zh: 胀破；因肿胀过度而破裂
entries.en: to burst from swelling; to split open from being bloated

entries.zh: 胀迫；肿胀紧迫、憋闷欲裂
entries.en: to burst from bloating; swollen and pressing tight

entries.zh: 胀开；因肿胀而撑裂开
entries.en: to split open from swelling

entries.zh: 以药攻破（肿毒、疮疖），使之溃破
entries.en: to break a swelling with medicine; to make a boil burst by medication
entries.notes: H 首字有[疑]（珀/砒），M 之 hiàm 亦难按常读对应，义从 L「以药攻破」推定

entries.zh: 打滚；像猪一样在地上翻滚沾污
entries.en: to wallow; to roll about (like a pig)

entries.zh: 在烂泥里打滚
entries.en: to wallow in the mud

entries.zh: （在床上）翻来覆去
entries.en: to toss and turn in bed
entries.notes: H 有[疑]（來/耒），然 M 之 lāy 正对 來，取 來

entries.zh: 卤莽；粗鲁莽撞（之人）
entries.en: rough; crude and reckless (person)
entries.notes: L 栏另混入汉字对音 chám jǐn，与 H/M 无涉，义从 鹵（鹵莽）及 L reboltoso 推定

entries.zh: （疑）吵嚷喧哗、滋事吵闹之状
entries.en: probably clamorous and disorderly; noisy brawling
entries.notes: H 唅 为罕见字且有[疑]，M 作 hó chap chap chap xiàng 不能连读成义，仅能按 reboltoso 之「滋事喧闹」义粗定

entries.zh: 卤莽；粗鲁冒失
entries.en: reckless; crude and impetuous

entries.zh: 无籍之徒；无赖、流氓（无户籍的流民）
entries.en: vagrant; unregistered rogue, knave

entries.zh: 奸盗诈伪；奸邪、盗窃、欺诈、虚伪之徒
entries.en: villainous; treacherous, thievish, deceitful and false

entries.zh: （疑）市井无赖、游手好闲之徒
entries.en: unclear; probably a street idler or rogue
entries.notes: H 巷究家 不成词，M xià yán gǔe 与 H 无法对应，只可按 L bellaco 定其大类

entries.zh: 鬼贼；狡诈说谎、行骗之徒
entries.en: cheat; swindler and liar (embustero)

entries.zh: 生事害人；搬弄是非、惹事害人
entries.en: troublemaker; slanderer who stirs up trouble and harms people

entries.zh: 浇漓（僥漓）；刻薄奸猾、好搬弄是非
entries.en: mean and crafty; backbiting and shallow-hearted
entries.notes: H 作僥漓（疑为澆漓之讹），M hiáu lý 与之相合，义从 L murmurador 侧定

entries.zh: 谄臣；谄媚逢迎之臣
entries.en: sycophant; fawning courtier

entries.zh: 搀杂；混杂不纯、杂乱无章
entries.en: jumbled; mixed up and disorderly
entries.notes: H 捕雜 非成词（疑摻雜之讹），M chap chap 取 雜 之音，义按 reboltoso「杂乱」义定

entries.zh: 逞强；好勇斗狠、争强好胜
entries.en: quarrelsome; fond of brawling and showing off strength
entries.notes: M 后半 thèng quiùo 不能连读，据前半 thẽng cuâng（逞強）定

entries.zh: 肆毒；肆意逞凶、好寻衅斗殴
entries.en: brawler; one who wreaks havoc and picks fights
